name: pnpm
description: Fast, disk space efficient package manager

subcommands.name: add
subcommands.description: Installs a package and any packages that it depends on

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Only adds the new dependency if it is found in the workspace

subcommands.name: install
subcommands.description: Install all dependencies for a project

options.name: --prod
options.description: Packages in devDependencies won't be installed

options.name: --frozen-lockfile
options.description: Don't generate a lockfile and fail if an update is needed

options.name: --ignore-scripts
options.description: Don't execute any scripts defined in the project package.json

subcommands.name: remove
subcommands.description: Removes packages from node_modules and from the project's package.json

subcommands.name: update
subcommands.description: Updates packages to their latest version based on the specified range

subcommands.name: audit
subcommands.description: Checks for known security issues with the installed packages

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: Print all the versions of packages that are installed

options.name: --depth
options.description: Max display depth of the dependency tree

subcommands.name: why
subcommands.description: Shows all packages that depend on the specified package

subcommands.name: exec
subcommands.description: Executes a shell command in scope of a project

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Checks for modified packages in the store

subcommands.name: add
subcommands.description: Adds new packages to the store

subcommands.name: prune
subcommands.description: Removes unreferenced packages from the store

subcommands.name: path
subcommands.description: Returns the path to the active store directory

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filtering allows you to restrict commands to specific subsets of packages
